name: Elf Archer
source:
Elf Archer is a friendly non-fightable Elf NPC who only appeared in Chapter 3 of Monster Girl Quest. She and several other elves were assisting the Enrikan residents against the Chimeras and Angels in Chapter 3. 

[Edited from [url=https://mgq.miraheze.org/wiki/Elf_Archer]Mon-musu Quest Wiki[/url]]
